title: Certify coefficient construction within the 84-bit A-stage bound
body:
## Summary

Close PR3089's coefficient-construction handoff with one isolated research package.

```text
Before: 84-bit bound covers endpoints and conversions; coefficient interiors excluded.
After:  all 9,992 prelude/A scalar macros have literal coefficient microstate coverage.
        Same seven-fractional-bit / P+20 common capacity, 84 bits at P=64.
```

Both pinned PR3076 providers and both orientations pass all three PR3078 policies. The target digit walk retains the 7,072-real-unit-instruction saving over the explicit scratch control through this interval, while never writing its source. The recipes are inherited; the new result binds their actual correlated intermediate values to the native capacity and checks source restoration and initially-zero scratch cleanup.

[Proof, exact sources, reproducible receipt, commands, scope and next questions](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/47a2bcec53667f490df6d40550e14a8ae465cba4/research/rank7-coefficient-capacity). [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18984598). Scientific main baseline `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6, unchanged at pre-submission refresh.

This is a conditional finite arithmetic lemma. Residual adapter endpoints remain hypotheses; adapter interiors, recursive approximation, centres/later consumer, physical bit costs, ownership, movement, stock and the complete invoice remain open. No new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the predecessor explicitly excludes arithmetic that manufactures scalar increments.
  **After:** every changed recipe register is checked by rational substitution and a separate denominator-2^32 integer interpreter, including exact HALF remainders and macro/source/scratch endpoints. The engines share the pinned native generator and normalized propagation.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay passes. Optimized Python 3.13 complete replay is byte-identical. All 12 behavioral groups pass, including endpoint-correct hidden grid and signed overflow, missing source restoration, missing scratch clear and wrong signs/ports.
- Fresh native compilation checks both 632-input providers/orientations, validates all 1,124 canonical frames per provider, and preserves the expected native checks. All 20 frozen inputs match exact Git source bytes. Ruff formatting/correctness checks, source compilation and all 36 committed-file byte checks pass. Two internal read-only reviews found no arithmetic defect; no independent human or proof-kernel review is claimed. Hosted CI remains separate.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-coefficient-capacity
```

Credit PR3089/3078/3086/3083/3084/3076/3060/3056, dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Cinna Davis/PR2226, DLamdata, eumemic/PR411, icekylinx, Tekalign and the retained native/geometry/owner lineage. Frozen notices remain intact. Development used substantial automated assistance. New work is Apache-2.0.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. One isolated research package and opt-in replay.

**Blast Radius:** isolated. Shared compilers, selected source/frontier, priorities and frozen predecessors are unchanged. The arithmetic certificate does not discharge the excluded physical obligations.
